implemented_requirements.evidence: dice.py defines a Dice class with a roll() method that returns two die values and a doubles flag.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Board layout with spaces (GO, properties, Chance, Tax, Jail, Free Parking, Go To Jail)
implemented_requirements.evidence: board.py defines a 24‑space Board with all required space types and their on_land hooks.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player model tracking money, position, owned properties, jail status
implemented_requirements.evidence: player.py defines a Player class with fields for money, position, properties, in_jail, etc.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Moving a player around the board based on dice rolls
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game class in game.py has no method that updates a player’s position or calls Board.get().

implemented_requirements.requirement: Buying unowned properties when landed on
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board spaces call Game.handle_property, but Game does not implement handle_property.
No Game logic for rent calculation or payment is present.
chance.py only contains a stub play(self) function; there is no ChanceDeck class or card definitions.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Jail mechanics (going to jail, paying fine, trying to roll doubles)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game constants for jail are defined, but no methods implement sending a player to jail, handling turns in jail, or paying the fine.
Board defines FreeParkingSpace.on_land calling Game.collect_free_parking_pot, but Game lacks that method.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Display of game information and player prompts
implemented_requirements.evidence: No code in any file prints board state, player balances, or asks for input beyond storing an input_fn in Game.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Overall game loop handling rounds, turn order, and win condition
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.__init__ sets up state, but there is no run loop; chance.py’s play() references undefined attributes (self.game_over, self.players, etc.).

critical_issues: Game class lacks essential methods: move_player, handle_property, handle_chance, charge, collect_free_parking_pot, send_to_jail, take_turn, check_game_over, declare_winner, etc.
ChanceDeck class is imported but not defined anywhere, making the import fail.
No implementation of the main game loop; the only loop present (in chance.py) references undefined state.
No user interaction code to prompt for buying decisions or jail actions.
Rent collection, property purchase, and monopoly rent doubling logic are missing.
The code will raise ImportError for missing chance module components and AttributeError for missing Game methods.
judge.summary: The repository provides a solid foundation for the board layout, dice, and player model, but the core game mechanics required by the benchmark are absent. Critical gameplay functions, chance card handling, jail rules, rent/payment logic, and any interactive loop are missing, making the implementation incomplete and unlikely to run as a playable Monopoly Go! game.
